items.body_excerpt: Sean is right that 6MOY is an award generally given to players with the best counting stats, and Dean Wade will never be close to that. But he might be one of the most important bench players in the entire league, especially because of how often he’ll be asked to slide into the starting lineup.

items.title: The #Cavs lost Dean Wade and didn’t land either LeBron James or Jaylen Brown.
items.author: Ethan Sands
items.body_excerpt:
The #Cavs lost Dean Wade and didn’t land either LeBron James or Jaylen Brown.

That leaves Cleveland with one wing taller than 6-foot-6: Nae’Qwan Tomlin.

Even if the organization adds another, it’ll still need Tomlin’s development to accelerate in 2027. #NBASky
